testsuite.name: me.rerere.rikkahub.data.remote.RemoteChatApiTest

testcase.name: a refused observe reports the refusal instead of a stream
a receipt the backend already recorded is returned as it stands
an unreadable send answer is unreachable rather than a receipt
backward page preserves fixed through cut and non message event coverage
closing an observer cancels the call and never stops the reply
stop names the session and is not retried behind the user's back
a committed delivery decodes beside an independent running attempt
send presents the completed uploads in order and the same text under one identity
read names the session and answers with the projection as sent
observe emits each cumulative snapshot whole and completes when the stream closes
receipt asks about the same identity and a null answer means not yet accepted
a refusal carries the backend's own code and message
a failed status is a failure even when the envelope claims success
a projected message carries its original attachment metadata
send presents one stable request identity and answers with the receipt
checkpoint adopts only explicit writer acknowledgement
old text only callers keep the default empty attachment list
slow rendering still receives the final complete snapshot
